title: Coordenador Administrativo
description:
Descrição

O Coordenador será responsável por apoiar a gestão da área administrativa/compras/faturamento, atuando como elo entre a estratégia definida pela gerência e a execução operacional do time. Terá como principal objetivo organizar processos, garantir a continuidade das rotinas da área e assegurar a qualidade, conformidade e eficiência das operações, permitindo que a gerência tenha maior foco em atividades estratégicas.

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e acompanhar as rotinas administrativas e de compras, garantindo o correto fluxo dos processos do pedido à entrega e faturamento;
  • Apoiar o gerente na organização, padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos da área, propondo ajustes, controles e indicadores;
  • Supervisionar as atividades do time operacional (analistas/assistentes), orientando, priorizando demandas e garantindo cumprimento de prazos;
  • Garantir que os pedidos de compra sejam corretamente registrados no sistema e acompanhados até o recebimento das mercadorias;
  • Assegurar a correta conferência das notas fiscais, incluindo condições comerciais, tributação, CFOP e demais requisitos fiscais;
  • Atuar preventivamente na identificação de riscos operacionais, fiscais e de retrabalho, propondo soluções e melhorias;
  • Manter a integração entre as áreas de compras, fiscal, financeiro, estoque, comercial e faturamento, garantindo alinhamento das informações;
  • Apoiar na análise de divergências entre pedido, nota fiscal e mercadoria recebida, coordenando as tratativas com fornecedores e áreas internas;
  • Criar indicadores operacionais da área reportando resultados à gerência;
  • Garantir a continuidade das operações da área;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e capacitação do time, promovendo boas práticas e padronização das rotinas.
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro, RJ
  • Regime de contratação de tipo: Efetivo – CLT

title: MEDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Main responsibilities

Promover e preservar a saúde dos colaboradores no ambiente de trabalho, por meio de ações de medicina preventiva, assistencial e ocupacional, conforme a legislação vigente e as normas da empresa.

Realizar exames médicos admissionais, periódicos, de retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissionais conforme exigências da NR-7 (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional – PCMSO);

Elaborar, coordenar e implementar o PCMSO;

Avaliar as condições de saúde dos colaboradores, identificando fatores de risco ocupacional;

Emitir e controlar atestados de saúde ocupacional (ASO);

Participar de programas de qualidade de vida e prevenção de doenças no ambiente de trabalho;

Analisar e acompanhar afastamentos médicos, atuando junto ao INSS e à perícia médica quando necessário;

Assessorar tecnicamente os setores da empresa quanto às ações de promoção e vigilância em saúde;

Apoiar a CIPA e demais comissões internas de saúde e segurança;

Trabalhar em conjunto com o Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho na identificação e mitigação de riscos à saúde.

Requirements and skills

Graduação completa em Medicina;

Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho (com título de especialista reconhecido pelo CRM);

Registro ativo no CRM;

Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e normas regulamentadoras;

Habilidades em comunicação, ética, sigilo e trabalho em equipe.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Escala: 30h semanais

Horário: a combinar

Overview

A Stone: Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Relacionamento com o Cliente:

Para atingir a missão de ajudar a jornada das pessoas empreendedoras, o nosso time tem o compromisso de resolver as demandas dos(as) clientes, garantindo uma solução eficaz e um atendimento de excelência.

Para nós, o cliente é a razão do nosso negócio e por isso temos um compromisso de extrema importância: proporcionar um atendimento acolhedor, rápido e resolutivo a fim de garantir que nossos(as) usuários(as) tenham mais tempo para focar em seus negócios.

Como é ser um(a) Líder de Operação - Relacionamento com Cliente:

Se você tem paixão por pessoas, possui habilidades de liderança, gosta de um ambiente dinâmico e inovador, essa oportunidade é para você. Somos um ecossistema de empresas de tecnologia, na incansável busca das melhores soluções para apoiar integralmente a nossa razão: o empreendedor brasileiro.

Temos uma oportunidade para ser o(a) Líder de Operações, na Stone Pagamentos. Nosso time é o número 1 em atendimento no país, oferecendo suporte 24 horas por dia com a garantia de agilidade e eficiência nos canais do telefone, chat, e-mail e whatsapp.

Você precisará carregar um propósito muito claro: ajudar quem empreende a fazer os melhores negócios, pois não medimos esforços em tornar a indústria mais justa e igualitária para donos e donas de negócio, nossas maiores razões.

Nossa cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It

Live the Ride

title: Enterprise Account Executive - LATAM
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.
  • *Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.
  • *Preferred location: Brazil (Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro); Mexico City

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice To Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

Indicators of Success

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

How We Work

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

The Most Important Thing

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE

We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN

We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE

We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE

We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Description

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Planning & Operational Readiness
  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
  • Operational Coordination & Delivery
  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
  • Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure
  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
  • Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution
  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Team & Contractor Coordination
  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Descrição da vaga

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);

  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;

  • Atuar como facilitador para a solução das demandas dos clientes e prospects;

  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. title: Onboarding Manager (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , MonetizeMore focuses on proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts—you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. 2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher\'s specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. 3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-to-day Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.

As a Technical Supervisor Electrical & Instrumentation , you play a crucial coordinating role in ensuring the safety, reliability and quality of our electrical LV/HV installations and electrical work equipment across all our sites and vessels.

Rather than a purely hands-on technician position, this is a supervisory and organisational role , focused on electrical safety, compliance, inspections, documentation, and the correct execution of work by internal staff and subcontractors.

You will work across all our offices and yards, containing Heijningen (workshop), Rotterdam (warehouse), Eindhoven (Research & Development) and Enschede (fabrication). Occasionally, you will also travel offshore to support our vessels.

Your most important tasks will be:

Electrical safety & compliance

  • Ensure the safe operation of all LV/HV electrical installations and electrical work equipment.
  • Develop, implement and safeguard policies regarding electrical safety in accordance with applicable standards and legislation.
  • Establish and maintain access regulations for areas with electrical hazards.
  • Organise and coordinate periodic inspections of installations and equipment.
  • Ensure timely remediation of any identified defects.
  • Conduct electrical safety risk analyses and internal audits to continuously improve safety and reliability.

Procedures & documentation

  • Prepare work procedures for operation, maintenance and inspection of installations, including procedures for isolation and making installations inactive.
  • Keep technical documentation up to date and maintain records of incidents and relevant work activities.
  • Collect and provide information for as‑built drawings and diagrams.

Coordination & supervision

  • Supervise electrical activities carried out by subcontractors and third parties.
  • Ensure safe, efficient and compliant execution of works on board and on site.
  • Coordinate with internal technical staff and advise crew where required.
  • Appoint competent and qualified personnel where necessary, and ensure training and instruction needs are met.
  • Prepare annual and multi‑year (5–10 year) maintenance, improvement and modification budgets in collaboration with budget holders and internal stakeholders.
  • Draft technical specifications for new or upgraded installations.

Support & cooperation

  • Support Equipment Electricians with troubleshooting and maintenance activities when required (not as primary focus).
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, procedures and technologies used within the organisation.

What we expect from you

In order to qualify for this job, you should recognize yourself in (most of) the following requirements:

  • Good command of both English (the main language at Allseas) and Dutch, as a lot of technical documents are in Dutch.
  • Minimum MBO degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a similar role within an industrial environment.
  • Experience within the offshore, dredging, construction or shipbuilding industry is a great asset (but not a must).
  • Knowledge of relevant legislation and standards (e.g. Arbowet, NEN 1010 is a plus).
  • NEN 3140 / 3840 IV or WV certification (or willingness to obtain); STIPEL certification is a strong asset.
  • Accurate, flexible and cost‑aware professional with a creative attitude.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel and work abroad or offshore.

What we offer

Working at Allseas allows you the chance to work in a dynamic, fast‑paced, entrepreneurial environment, with creative thinking, collaboration and down‑to‑earth culture at its core.

You can expect

  • Competitive industry benchmarked salary (negotiable) and additional performance based raises and bonuses.
  • One of the best pension plans that are currently on the market.
  • 30 holidays days per year.
  • A lot of flexibility in your working hours.
  • Extensive trainings and development programmes, study budgets and coaching.
  • Internal clubs, committees, parties and (sportive) events.

Interested?

If you feel that you can contribute to our business by diving into this exciting opportunity, we are looking forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter! Please apply via the ‘Apply’ button.

An online personality questionnaire can be part of the selection procedure.

Is this the opportunity you are looking for?

Please share your CV and motivation, and we’ll get in touch.

FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Job Description

The position

Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Sr Manager Recruitment, the Coordinator, Recruitment is responsible for the recruitment of a talented and diverse workforce required to plan and deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

This role plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament by, attracting top talent and overseeing the implementation and management of a best-in-class recruitment experience.
Key responsibilities

  • End-to-end recruitment process of individuals hired under FIFA27, including sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interviewing, obtaining reference and background checks, offer/employment contract distribution.
  • Candidate Management : Coordinating interviews, managing candidate communications, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience.
  • Scheduling : Organizing interview schedules and meetings between candidates and hiring managers.
  • Administrative Support : Handling paperwork, maintaining recruitment databases, and assisting with onboarding processes.
  • Job Posting : Creating and posting job advertisements on various platforms.
  • Collaboration : Working closely with FIFA Workforce Management and FIFA27 hiring managers to understand staffing needs and requirements.

Your profile

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in recruitment or human resources, preferably at a major sporting event or other large-scale mega event
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other HR software
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English & Portuguese to interact effectively with candidates and internal teams
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and schedules
    Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with hiring managers and team members
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

The Production Supervisor will support BW Energy's production operations on Brazilian offshore assets.   • Engage in continuous improvement, identifying unsafe conditions and ensuring corrective actions per procedures

Qualifications

  • HNC (Higher National Certificate) in Chemical/Petrochemical field
  • Engineering degree
  • Solid and proven experience in production operations

Experience

  • Experience in chemical/petrochemical industry with offshore operations
  • Extensive experience in production departments
  • Experience with FPSO operations and process plant systems (preferred)

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Vision

At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well‑run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end‑to‑end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a "thinking partner" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.

Who We’re Looking For

The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's "20% focus" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision‑making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near‑zero. If you are a high‑nuance individual who "just gets it" and thrives in a fast‑paced environment, this role is for you.

Why You Should Join Us

  • AI Frontier: Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI‑driven automation.
  • Career Growth: We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High‑Impact Environment: Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem‑solving.

Role Responsibilities

The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership: Manage the CEO's inbox end‑to‑end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero "emotional leakage".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense: Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics: Execute end‑to‑end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on‑call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness: Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance: Review deals weekly, ensure follow‑up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management: Fully own and update all CEO‑related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit‑ready and searchable.
  • Small‑Scope Project Management: Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.

Skills & Attributes We're Looking For

  • Methodical & Nuanced: You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision‑making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience: Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high‑growth, corporate, or communications‑heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech‑Savviness: Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence: You have a professional audio / video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO‑facing interactions.
  • Coachability: You believe feedback is the "breakfast of champions" and iterate quickly based on guidance.

Our Values

  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI‑driven.

Compensation & Location

Compensation: Starts at $2,200 USD

Location: Remote (Working within 8 AM – 5 PM CST is preferred).

Application & Selection Process

TO APPLY

Send your Resume (PDF titled "Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf") to Operations+ .

Record a short demo video (2 – 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise

Behavioral Assessments: Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three‑Step Interview sequence: Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world’s best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez’s Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people’s lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it!

Responsibilities

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

This is a contract position. Up to 40 hours weekly. Remote. Selection Process

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Manter a farmácia, enfermaria e isolamento em perfeito estado de conservação, ordem, limpeza e higiene;
  • Comunicar, por escrito, ao Comandante, via Imediato, sempre que internar qualquer pessoa na enfermaria de bordo, bem como a existência de qualquer pessoa atacada de moléstia infecto-contagiosa ou sujeita à notificação compulsória, providenciando, nesses casos, as medidas necessárias para evitar o contágio da moléstia;
  • Cumprir, rigorosamente, as instruções do Departamento Nacional de Saúde ou de outro órgão governamental competente;
  • Examinar, diariamente, os gêneros que saírem dos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas de bordo, para a preparação dos alimentos;
  • Assistir, obrigatoriamente, a entrada do material de rancho a bordo, a fim de examinar a sua qualidade, comunicando ao Comandante, via Imediato, qualquer irregularidade, inclusive sobre o estado dos locais onde são guardados os mantimentos;
  • Fiscalizar o embarque de passageiros por ocasião de sua entrada a bordo, recusando todos aqueles que forem portadores de moléstia infecto-contagiosa ou de outras, que por sua natureza não possam ser tratadas durante a viagem;
  • Acompanhar o Comandante por ocasião das inspeções às diferentes dependências de bordo;
  • Manter-se a par do estado de saúde dos tripulantes e dos que não estiverem em condições de permanecer a bordo, informando ao Imediato;
  • Atender, independente de horário, a qualquer acidente pessoal ocorrido a bordo, prestando à vitima os socorros de urgência necessários e, como técnico, classificando as lesões;
  • Atender à visita das autoridades sanitárias nos portos nacionais e estrangeiros;
  • Prestar informações ao Comandante, via Imediato, sobre o estado sanitário de bordo;
  • Acompanhar o bordo os serviços de desratização, dedetização, desbaratização, fumigação, descontaminação e desinfecção;
  • Permanecer no posto médico de bordo durante o horário previamente determinado pelo Comandante;
  • Manter, devidamente inventariado, todo o material de saúde (material cirúrgico, medicamentos e utensílios de farmácia) e material de primeiros socorros, zelando pela sua conservação e respondendo por qualquer falta a encontrada;
  • Formular os pedidos de medicamentos e materiais necessários, encaminhando-os ao Comandante, via Imediato
  • Apresentar relação do material de saúde existente a bordo que tiver que ser entregue às autoridades de cada porto.
  • Cumprir a política do sistema de gestão oceânica, na qual cada indivíduo deve responsabilizar-se pelos aspectos de qualidade e segurança de suas atividades, assim como pela preservação do meio ambiente em que as realiza.

  • Superior completo em Enfermagem, com especialização em Enfermagem do Trabalho;
  • COREN ativo;
  • Experiência com medicina ocupacional e no regime offshore;
  • ACLS e ITLS;
  • THUET e CBSP.

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management / implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organizational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

Your profile

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • ITIL foundations
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. title: Head of Event Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure

  1. Drive FIFA’s leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.
  2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.
  3. Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project.
  4. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

Key responsibilities

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC’s overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.
  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

Your profile

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity
  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
  • Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
  • Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
  • Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
  • Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Right to work in Brazil (desirable)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Wireless Architect
description:
Job Title: WirelessDomain Architect (Arista focused)

Location: Brazil (Must be located in Brazil)

Role: 90 Day Contract to Hire (Potential to convert from Contract to Full Time Employee with benefits)

Position Overview

The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands‑on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture . This position demands expertise in Arista’s next-generation wireless platforms , with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) solutions.

The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre‑sales technical scoping, and escalation support , operating as both an architect and hands‑on technical mentor to delivery teams.

Core Responsibilities

Wireless Architecture & Design

  • Serve as the primary wireless domain expert , with deep, hands‑on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud‑managed technologies .

  • Design enterprise‑grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista’s cognitive networking capabilities, including:

    • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML‑driven automation planes.

    • Cognitive Wi‑Fi platforms that provide data‑driven telemetry, real‑time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve.

    • Multi‑radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting‑edge standards such as Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi‑Fi 7 , zero‑touch onboarding, and high‑density coverage models.

  • Develop high‑level and low‑level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating:

    • RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms.

    • Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration.

    • Flexible data path options and scalable control‑plane architectures inherent to CloudVision’s cognitive approach.

Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution

  • Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles .

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers through:

    • Zero‑touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV-CUE .

    • Implementation of AI/ML‑enabled analytics and automated remediation features.

    • Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions.

  • Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management.

Pre‑Sales Scoping & Technical Support

  • Participate in pre‑sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership.

  • Provide detailed input on:

    • The effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi‑Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures .

    • Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases.

  • Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud‑native wireless technologies.

Escalation & Customer Assurance

  • Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to:

    • Wi‑Fi behavior under load and real‑world spectrum conditions.

    • Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML‑driven recommendations.

    • Cross‑domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement.

  • Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery.

Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)

  • Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON‑NEGOTIABLE

    • Hands‑on design, deployment, and operational experience with:

      • Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi access point platforms (Wi‑Fi 6/6E/7).

      • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics.

      • AI/ML‑driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking.

  • HPE Aruba Wireless

    • Enterprise Aruba wireless design and deployment experience.

  • Juniper Wireless

    • Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms.

  • Cisco Wireless

    • Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures.

  • Nile Wireless

    • Exposure to or hands‑on experience with Nile wireless solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment , with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions .

  • Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time.

  • Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders .

  • Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting.

  • Multi‑vendor wireless migration expertise.

  • Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies.

  • Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates.

Role Characteristics

  • Combination of technical leadership, hands‑on execution, pre‑sales engagement, and post‑deployment escalation support .

  • Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements.

  • Expected to deliver high‑quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams.

As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. In our company, your work directly contributes to a more sustainable world. Whether you're driving projects forward, optimizing operations, or leading strategic initiatives, you're contributing to our mission to improve the global environment and foster local development.

At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic Vision-
  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

We are looking for a SAP PMO who wants to learn and transform their career. In this role is responsible for managing the governance, processes, and resources for SAP projects, ensuring successful delivery by overseeing planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder communication, and adherence to methodologies. The SAP PMO ensures that all projects—whether software, infrastructure, or process-related—follow the same methodology, use the same tools, and report indicators in a standardized way, providing consolidated visibility to senior management.

In this role, you will:

  • Standardize Methodologies: Define and update the project management “toolkit” (schedule templates, communication plans, risk matrices) to be used by all Project Managers.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure that projects follow approval phases and internal processes, guaranteeing compliance with company standards.
  • Report Consolidation (Dashboards): Gather data from multiple projects to create executive reports on status, timelines, and overall portfolio health (with no focus on costs).
  • Resource and Capacity Management (Capacity Planning): Monitor team workload to identify staffing bottlenecks and help prioritize which project should start first.
  • Support and Mentorship: Assist Project Managers and Product Owners in resolving methodological conflicts and using management tools.
  • Corporate Risk Management: Identify risks that recur across multiple projects and propose structural actions to eliminate them at their source.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze lessons learned from completed projects to optimize workflows for future cycles.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or related fields.

  • Exceptional Organization: Ability to structure large volumes of information from different sources.
  • Diplomacy and Impartiality: Skill in auditing projects and pointing out deviations constructively and neutrally.
  • Analytical Vision: Ability to identify failure patterns in schedules before they become critical issues.
  • Teaching Ability: Skill in training others and explaining methodologies in a simple and applicable way.
  • Critical Thinking: Ability to challenge current processes in pursuit of simplification and agility (debureaucratization).

Desired Skills:

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or PMO-specific certifications such as those from PMO Global Alliance.
