Atendente de Farmácia - Ilha do Governador

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: OFICIAL DE MANUTENÇÃO
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Executar reparos em geral nas dependências da empresa, incluindo serviços de pintura, alvenaria, gesso e piso, bem como a manutenção periódica da rede hidráulica do condomínio. Executar operações básicas no sistema de refrigeração como Parametrizações, Operações e Manobras em tubulações de Ar Condicionado, Operar Bombas, Compressores, Fancoils, Torre de Refrigeração, assim como realizar atividades básicas de manutenção autonoma, como Limpezar da Torre, trocas de filtro, trocas e reposição de óleo e verificação de funcionamento de instrumentos. O Oficial de Manutenção é responsável pela pintura de tubulações, grades portões, pilares, piso, teto e paredes em geral, executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva no sistema hidráulico, inspeções rotineiras em bombas hidráulicas e banheiros, a fim de garantir seu perfeito funcionamento, identificar e promover reparos em telhados, organizar a oficina de trabalho.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como?

  • Executar trabalhos de pintura e retoques em todas as dependências do shopping, com tinta PVA, esmalte, epoxi ou acrílica nas áreas que necessitem.
  • Realizar pinturas em mesas, cadeiras, armários, portas e janelas, onde tal necessite.
  • Realizar preparo de superfícies (lixamento, aplicação de massa plástica, gesso, etc) antes de realizar pintura final.
  • Executar serviços e reparos em alvenaria, gesso em todas as dependências do condomínio, incluindo em paredes, pilares, pisos, calçadas e forros, visando apoiar a realização das atividades de manutenção civil no empreendimento.
  • Realizar demolições de pequeno porte. Garantir correta remoção do entulho da obras.
  • Confeccionar alçapões, paredes e caixas de concreto.
  • Revisar periodicamente os reservatórios de água e poços artesianos, incluindo rede hidráulica e medidores de consumo.
  • Vistoriar periodicamente a rede hidráulica dos sanitários; casa de bombas, bebedouros, mictórios, vasos sanitários, sifões, válvulas de descarga e acessórios.
  • Trocar válvulas, torneiras, sifões sempre que necessário e limpeza nas caixa sanfonadas.
  • Desentupir a rede de esgoto, vasos sanitários (com retirada e recolocação) sempre que necessário. Realizar limpeza de rede principal de esgoto do mall e áreas técnicas.
  • Realizar reparos nas instalações quando houver ocorrências de vazamento. Manutenção em tubulações de PVC, aço carbono, ferro fundido e cobre (SPK, hidrante, água potável e gás).
  • Controlar rede de sprinklers, despressurizando e pressurizando quando necessário, assim como executar soldas do tipo mig, tig, convencional, oxiacetileno e estanho.
  • Apoio nas atividades gerais da área e manutenção (sinalização de áreas, fornecer papel para vitrines de lojas, apoio a jardinagem e a equipe da limpeza, montagem de tapumes e outros).
  • Manter limpo e organizado a área de trabalho, na oficina de manutenção, nos depósitos e corredores Técnicos.
  • Operar os equipamentos de ar condicionado realizando ronda para verificar as áreas técnicas, verificar o livro de ocorrências, partir e desligar máquinas. Executar reparos e ajustes operacionais necessários.
  • Verificar nível de água das torres, verificar nível de água do reservatório e sistema de tratamento e boias de nível.
  • Verificar o funcionamento das bombas, verificar nível de óleo dos equipamentos.
  • Realizar limpeza das torres de refrigeração.
  • Realizar troca e limpeza de filtros de fancoils, filtros de bebedouros, filtros de sistema de ventilação e exaustão.
  • Monitorar o sistema por leitura de instrumentos e alarmes como dados de temperatura externa, temperatura da água gelada, umidade do ar, temperatura de bulbo úmido.
  • Atender chamados de clientes/lojistas a fim de detectar problema de sistemas hidráulicos e climatização e corrigir, se possível. Caso contrário dar as devidas orientações para o lojista chamar a sua própria equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar Interação e registro de atividades preventivas e corretivas no Sistema de gestão de Manutenção (PRISMA).

OBSERVAÇÕES

Observações relevantes ao cargo.

Na Bunge, nosso objetivo é conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustível essenciais para o mundo. Como uma fornecedora líder de soluções para o agronegócio, nossa equipe de aproximadamente 37.000 colaboradores dedicados atua em parceria com agricultores ao redor do mundo para movimentar commodities agrícolas de onde são produzidas para onde são necessárias — de maneira mais rápida, inteligente e eficiente. Somos uma empresa líder mundial em originação, armazenamento, distribuição, além de processamento e refino de oleaginosas, oferecendo um amplo portfólio de óleos, gorduras e proteínas de origem vegetal. Atuamos lado a lado com nossos clientes em ambas as pontas da cadeia de valor para fornecer produtos de qualidade e desenvolver soluções inovadoras e personalizadas que atendam às necessidades em constante evolução dos consumidores. Com mais de 200 anos de experiência e presença em mais de 50 países, temos o compromisso de fortalecer a segurança alimentar global, promover a sustentabilidade e contribuir para a prosperidade das comunidades onde operamos. A Bunge tem sede registrada em Genebra, Suíça, e sua sede corporativa está localizada em St. Louis, Missouri, EUA. Saiba mais em bunge.com.br.

Diariamente, nossos profissionais incorporam os valores que são a essência da Bunge:

  • SOMOS UM SÓ TIME – Colaborativo, respeitoso e inclusivo
  • LIDERAMOS O CAMINHO – Somos ágeis, Empoderados e inovadores
  • FAZEMOS O QUE É CERTO – Com segurança, de forma sustentável e com integridade

Reconhecemos que nosso sucesso depende da variedade de perspectivas que cada um de nossos colaboradores agrega à Bunge. Estamos empenhados em promover práticas para nutrir uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Globalmente, apoiamos os Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres, de ONU Mulheres. No Brasil, somos associados ao Mover - Movimento pela Equidade Racial, e fomos eleitos pela ferramenta global Disability Index Report® como um dos melhores locais para se trabalhar em relação à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência. Atuamos continuamente em prol de nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em todas as comunidades onde atuamos.

Se você se identifica com esses valores, junte-se a nós! Valorizamos e investimos em pessoas que acreditam em nosso propósito e o vivenciam com entusiasmo a cada dia – pessoas que têm #OrgulhodeSerBunge

  15. Ensure timely and effective contributions to reporting and investigation of all incidents where required.
  16. Contribute To The Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies

  18. Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment

  21. Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  22. Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  23. Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  24. Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  25. Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  26. Emergency Response
  27. Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).

title: PROMOTOR MERCHANDISING MOTORIZADO -RJ Rio de Janeiro - RJ Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A. Somos um time que Cuidamos da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade. Entendemos que para obtermos os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais. Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz, e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!

Main responsibilities

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requirements and skills

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.
  • Possuir motocicleta própria;
  • Possuir CNH categoria A.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região

Additional information

Além de um ambiente desenvolvedor, oferecemos ao nosso time:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com faculdades;
  • Convênio com farmácias;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Wellhub
  • Descontos nos nossos produtos em nossa loja online.

title: Supervisor de Marketing
description:
Overview

Quem Somos? ✨ Bem-vindo ao Universo El Misti. No El Misti Hostels Pousadas, acreditamos que tudo compartilhado é muito melhor. Há mais de 24 anos, unimos amor por viagens, pessoas e cultura para transformar sonhos em experiências inesquecíveis. Somos mais que um lugar para dormir — somos um ponto de encontro entre pessoas do mundo inteiro e a energia vibrante do Rio de Janeiro.

A Nossa Missão

Oferecer mais do que hospedagem: criamos conexões genuínas entre hóspedes, equipe, a cidade maravilhosa e causas sociais. Somos apaixonados por servir e encantar, e cada detalhe da jornada do hóspede é planejado para ser memorável.

Por Que Trabalhar Conosco?

Trabalhar no El Misti é entrar para uma tribo apaixonada, diversa e comprometida com:

  • Amor pelo que faz
  • Trabalho em equipe de verdade
  • Respeito e empatia em todas as relações
  • Aprendizado contínuo
  • Inovação com propósito

Aqui, valorizamos cada pessoa que soma com nosso propósito. Investimos em capacitação, feedbacks constantes e oportunidades reais de crescimento. Sabemos que quando você cresce, a empresa cresce com você.

A Magia que Nos Move

Inspirados pelo modelo Disney de atendimento, acreditamos que todos têm um papel essencial na criação da magia. Nosso atendimento vai além da expectativa: entregamos experiências. E tudo começa com pessoas encantadoras como você .

O Que Esperamos de Você?

Buscamos pessoas que:

  • Têm brilho nos olhos e energia positiva
  • Sabem se comunicar com empatia
  • Curtem trabalhar em equipe e servir com alegria
  • Aprendem rápido, erram pequeno e acertam grande
  • Agem com responsabilidade e sentem orgulho do que entregam

Localização

Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Contrato

PJ

Descrição de Atividades

  • Implementar as iniciativas de marketing e crescimento da empresa, garantindo que todas as atividades estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócios e otimizadas para alcançar os melhores resultados.
  • Supervisionar, inspirar e promover o desenvolvimento profissional da equipe de marketing assegurando uma cultura de alto desempenho e colaboração.
  • Planejar e supervisionar a alocação de recursos financeiros para as campanhas e projetos de marketing, garantindo que o investimento seja eficaz e alinhado com as metas estratégicas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho claros e mensuráveis para avaliar o sucesso das estratégias de marketing e crescimento, utilizando esses dados para fazer ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho onde a comunicação e a colaboração entre os pilares de marketing sejam eficientes, garantindo que todos os esforços estejam sincronizados e voltados para os mesmos objetivos.
  • Pesquisar e se manter informado sobre as últimas tendências e inovações em marketing e crescimento, aplicando insights relevantes para aprimorar continuamente as estratégias da empresa.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros departamentos e lideranças dentro da empresa para garantir que as estratégias de marketing e crescimento estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem integrada e coesa.
  • Monitorar e analisar dados de mercado e tendências de consumo para informar decisões estratégicas e ajustar as abordagens de marketing conforme necessário.
  • Avaliar o desempenho de todas as atividades e campanhas de marketing, apresentando relatórios regulares à direção e ajustando estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento e implementação de conteúdo de marketing e campanhas publicitárias para garantir consistência com a voz da marca e os objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar e coordenar projetos que buscam inovar nas estratégias e ferramentas de marketing, utilizando princípios de gestão de projetos para assegurar que os objetivos sejam atingidos dentro do prazo e orçamento estipulados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovável
  • Formado em Marketing
  • Pro-atividade
  • Dedicação
  • Organização
  • Responsabilidade
  • Espírito de liderança
  • Cordialidade
  • Pontualidade
  • Saber se comunicar com clareza
  • Senso crítico apurado

Remuneração

R$4.000,-

  • Remuneração Variável (PLR + RV)

Responsabilidades e funções comercial e administrativa, para melhor atendimento e geração de negócios aproveitando o fluxo das agências. Faz gestão da carteira compartilhada e, em alguns locais, efetua o atendimento de clientes PJ E1 e Van Gogh. Faz gestão do numerário e tem responsabilidade sobre chave e segredo da agência e do cofre. Fundada em 1995 em Belo Horizonte/MG, a CTA é uma empresa especializada em consultoria ambiental, terceirização de serviços, processos (BPO) e gestão de pessoas, com sede em Duque de Caxias/RJ e escritórios comerciais na Ilha do Governador. Surgiu para atender à demanda de indústrias químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas, automotivas e outros setores por soluções de monitoramento e gestão ambiental. Ao longo de mais de 25 anos, consolidou expertise em projetos ambientais e, a partir de 2018, expandiu sua atuação para projetos de engenharia, especialmente no setor de Óleo e Gás. Seus pilares são ética, respeito ao meio ambiente e máxima segurança operacional. A CTA apoia seus clientes na eficiência operacional, redução de riscos e custos, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade e a qualidade de vida.

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027” ) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between FIFA Functional Areas, Local Entities, contractors, and external stakeholders for sustainable cleaning and waste management services.
  • Lead and manage cleaning and waste management team, ensuring efficiency and high performance.
  • Develop and implement the Sustainable Waste management strategy and cleaning operational plan, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s requirements.
  • Develop and manage sustainable cleaning and waste management services budget, ensuring cost control and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the planning, installation, and operations of temporary waste management infrastructure across stadiums, training sites, and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Ensure full integration of cleaning and waste management requirements, maximizing the use of existing venue infrastructure while meeting FIFA standards and event operational needs.
  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of sustainable cleaning and waste management services, managing resources, partners, suppliers, and contractors to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.
  • Oversee the planning and delivery of temporary power, lighting, and other essential technical services for Resource Recovery Centers.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA’s facility management standards.
  • Collaborate with stadium facility management teams, suppliers, and local authorities to guarantee operational readiness by the highest sustainability standards.
  • Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with local authorities the process to secure necessary permits and approvals.
  • Track and report on project progress, identifying risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in service planning and delivery.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Resource Management, Economics, Sustainability, Facility Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience planning and executing sustainable cleaning and waste management services for major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of leading cleaning and waste management service teams in FIFA tournaments or similar global events.
  • Experience in budget management, procurement, and supplier coordination.
  • Strong understanding of stakeholders’ requirements and responsibilities to deliver efficient and sustainable operations.
  • Extensive knowledge of cleaning and waste management delivery, temporary infrastructure, and venue technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities. Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day‑to‑day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.

The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.

  • Client Group Management:
  • Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).

  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
  • Accreditation Process Delivery:
  • Manage the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.

  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  • Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Team Leadership & Support:

  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.

  • Support on‑site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required.
  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:

  • Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.

title: Analista de Operações Logísticas - Rio de Janeiro, AMZL
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros, em turno 4x3. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em turno 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back.

Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entreda dos partners logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses partners. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos partners logísticos in loco.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos partners logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os partners logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais;
  • Bacharelado em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.;
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).;
  • Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários partners simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes.;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 10% do tempo.;
  • Inglês básico.;
  • Inglês avançado.;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de processos, métricas e resolução de problemas.;
  • Experiência em Logística, Transportes.;

title: [2026] BR - Coordenador(a) de New Adventures - DL
description:
Overview

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Na L’Oréal Grande Público, nossa missão é democratizar o melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L\'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York e a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A L’Oréal Grande Público é a maior divisão do grupo L\'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

A área Comercial da L\'Oréal é uma verdadeira força motriz por trás do sucesso das nossas marcas e clientes! A nossa equipe comercial é composta por profissionais estratégicos, analíticos, criativos e orientados para resultados, que trabalham em parceria com nossos clientes para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios. Além disso, você terá a chance de trabalhar com os produtos mais inovadores e desejados do mercado de beleza. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa jornada incrível, onde você terá a oportunidade de deixar a sua marca no mundo da beleza!

Missão da Vaga

Missão da Vaga: Na divisão de Luxo da L\'Oréal, a inovação e a exploração de novos horizontes de negócios são essenciais para manter nossa liderança no mercado de prestígio. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil empreendedor, forte visão comercial e sólida base analítica para liderar a frente de New Ventures.

Sua missão será identificar, desenhar e implementar novos modelos de negócio, parcerias estratégicas e canais de venda que elevem a experiência do consumidor de luxo e gerem novas fontes de receita. Você será o(a) arquiteto(a) de projetos que conectam o desejo do consumidor com a viabilidade financeira e a excelência operacional, atuando como um catalisador de crescimento para marcas icônicas como Lancôme, Giorgio Armani e Yves Saint Laurent.

Suas Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento e Prospecção de Novos Negócios: Identificar e avaliar oportunidades de expansão de mercado, novos canais de distribuição e serviços inovadores. Liderar a estruturação de business cases para novas iniciativas, desde a concepção da ideia até o plano de execução (Go-to-Market).
  • Interface Comercial e Negociação: Liderar frentes comerciais para viabilizar novos modelos de parceria e prospecção de parceiros estratégicos. Atuar na negociação de termos comerciais, garantindo que as novas iniciativas estejam alinhadas com o posicionamento de prestígio das marcas e tragam rentabilidade sustentável para a divisão.
  • Sinergia entre Marketing e Branding: Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Marketing (Zona e Brasil) para garantir que os novos projetos reflitam o DNA de luxo das marcas. Desenvolver estratégias de ativação e aquisição de clientes para os novos canais, garantindo uma jornada do consumidor de forma fluida e personalizada.
  • Análise Financeira e Gestão de P&L: Construir modelos financeiros robustos (P&L) para os projetos de New Ventures, incluindo projeções de vendas, análise de margem e retorno sobre investimento (ROI). Monitorar o desempenho financeiro das iniciativas após o lançamento, sendo responsável por reportar resultados e ajustar rotas para garantir o cumprimento das metas.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Atuar como o ponto focal multifuncional, conectando áreas como Supply Chain, Jurídico, TI e Finanças para viabilizar projetos complexos e disruptivos. Influenciar a tomada de decisão da alta liderança através de apresentações estruturadas e análises baseadas em dados.
  • Inteligência de Mercado e Tendências: Monitorar constantemente o ecossistema de beleza, startups e tendências de varejo global para antecipar movimentos do mercado e propor soluções de "vanguarda" que diferenciem a L\'Oréal Luxo da concorrência.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Experiência e Formação: Experiência consolidada em Desenvolvimento de Negócios, Gestão de Categorias, Planejamento Comercial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia no mercado de luxo ou beleza será considerada um forte diferencial. Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou Marketing.
  • Visão de Negócio 360°: Background comprovado que equilibre o atingimento das metas comerciais com o entendimento de branding (Marketing) e o rigor de análise de números (Financeiro).
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Domínio de Excel para analises financeira e análise de dados. Capacidade de transformar dados complexos em apresentações executivas claras e persuasivas.
  • Mindset Empreendedor: Perfil "hands-on" com resiliência para lidar com as incertezas de novos projetos e proatividade para buscar soluções criativas para problemas não estruturados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Excelentes habilidades interpessoais para navegar em uma estrutura matricial, capacidade de negociação e fluência para interagir com executivos de diferentes áreas.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado ideal para interação com os times globais e acompanhamento de tendências internacionais.
  • Possibilidades de crescimentos, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your profile

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

We’re looking for a versatile Social Media & Creative Growth Specialist to own and execute the content, design, and growth strategy across social platforms — including YouTube — to elevate MonetizeMore’s brand, engage publishers, and drive inbound lead generation. This role blends creative design, storytelling, and growth strategy to make complex ad‑tech topics accessible, build trust, and generate qualified publisher interest.

The ideal candidate will be a cross‑functional producer: part designer, part content strategist, part growth marketer — comfortable with graphic design, video creation, and social strategy, and passionate about turning ad‑tech know‑how into compelling content with real business impact.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Content & Video Strategy (YouTube + Social)

    • Optimize video metadata, thumbnails, and descriptions to maximize discoverability, SEO, and engagement.
  • Graphic & Visual Design
    • Create visually compelling graphics, diagrams, infographics, and motion‑graphics that simplify and clarify complex ad‑tech concepts.
    • Design assets for marketing, sales enablement, social posts, blog posts, product announcements, and educational content.
  • Social Media Management & Community Engagement
    • Manage and grow MonetizeMore’s presence across relevant social platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).

  • Lead Generation & Brand Awareness
    • Use content and social strategy to attract high‑intent publisher leads searching for ad‑tech solutions or publisher support.
    • Collaborate with sales and marketing to align content with lead‑gen goals and track performance metrics (views, engagement, leads, conversions).
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with product, sales, ad operations, and client success teams to understand product features, publisher pain points, and trends — then translate into content.
    • Support sales enablement with video and visual collateral (case studies, product explainers, onboarding content, policy update guides).
  • Continuous Improvement & Analytics
    • Track performance of content (video views, watch time, engagement, conversion to leads).
    • Analyze what works, iterate on content strategy, and continuously optimize for growth, reach, and revenue impact.

Qualifications & Skills

Required:

  • 3‑5 related years of experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in graphic design and video content creation (e.g., editing, motion graphics, thumbnails, design software).
  • Strong familiarity with YouTube (or other video platforms) — content production, optimization, SEO best practices, and audience growth.
  • Experience managing social media channels for a brand or B2B company.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/ad‑tech topics into clear, audience‑friendly content.
  • Creative mindset with a strategic growth orientation — comfortable thinking about content as a lead‑gen and branding asset, not just marketing fluff.
  • Ability to work in a fully remote, cross‑functional environment, collaborating with teams across time zones.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Background or familiarity with ad‑tech, digital publishing, programmatic advertising, or related industry.
  • Experience producing explainer videos, motion graphics, educational content, or tutorials.
  • Understanding of SEO, video SEO, and content performance analytics.
  • Experience supporting sales or business development teams through creative/sales‑enablement collateral.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Finance Coordinator provides administrative and financial operations support for the Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) department and serves as a critical liaison with procurement and accounts payable to ensure that financial activities associated with financial operations, philanthropic gifts, and grants are efficiently managed, maintained, and compliant with all applicable university policies, laws, and regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing procurement, accounts payable, and financial operations efficiently.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator assists with the development, management, and monitoring of the department\'s budget and financial operations. The role requires an experienced administrator with a strong background in bookkeeping, able to ensure the department\'s fiscal integrity and efficiency, and compliance with university policies. This position works collaboratively across DAR and extensively with colleagues in key financial offices, including the University Budget Office, Procurement and Contracting, and Accounts Payable. Will work with other campus partners as needed. Teamwork, collaboration, and effective communication both across the University and with other development staff, are essential.

Principal Accountabilities

Working closely with the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator primarily provides financial administrative support, including bookkeeping, entering requisitions, account reconciliation across the entire department. The role assists with managing and monitoring staff expenses to ensure the timely completion of expense reports. It supports the procurement process, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, and purchase order management, ensuring that all expenditures align with approved budget guidelines and university financial policies and procedures. Responsibilities include assisting with the preparation of financial reports and summaries for review by the Director of Administration and senior leadership, as well as assisting with the development of DAR’s annual budget and audits. The Finance Coordinator may also help to identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiencies within the department’s financial operations.

Core Competencies

  • Excellent administrative, bookkeeping, communication, and time management skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and work with data to inform reporting and task completion.
  • Ability to adhere to standard operating procedures to ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem-solve, take initiative, and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast-paced environment; and
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance, accounting, or bookkeeping
  • Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Suite, excel and budgeting software, familiarity with Workday preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Salary Range: $65,000 - $80,000

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

title: Syndication Video Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Note: This is a contract-to-hire position

MUST HAVE:

  • Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
  • Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
  • Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
  • Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
  • Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.

YOUR ROLE

You’ll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz’s video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you’ll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback.

This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
  • Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
  • Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
  • Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
  • Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
  • Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
  • Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
  • Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
  • Plan and maintain the video content calendar
  • Write, edit, and optimize video scripts
  • Provide detailed feedback to video editors and designers
  • Optimize thumbnails, titles, and on-screen graphics for engagement
  • Oversee video production workflows for speed, quality, and consistency
  • Manage freelance contributors and coordinate with internal stakeholders on budgets and payments
  • Conduct quality control on all video outputs
  • Track and report on video performance metrics and revenue

COMPETENCIES

  • Performance-Driven: Obsessed with engagement, watch time, and revenue outcomes
  • Detail-Oriented: Catches issues before they go live and pushes for constant improvement
  • Strategic & Tactical: Thinks big-picture while staying deeply involved in execution
  • Ownership Mentality: Treats the video business as their own and takes responsibility for results
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-changing environment and adjusts strategy based on performance data
  • Collaborative: Works closely with editorial, design, and operations partners
  • Coachability: Welcomes feedback and actively seeks ways to improve systems and output

Overview

WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US? At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Responsibilities

  • Your role: Develop, deliver, document and support robust and stable backend application features, third-party integrations and infrastructure across a breadth of services and environments.
  • Outcomes (Performance Expectations):
    • Backend Application Features & Third-Party Integrations
      • Support the development and implementation of backend features and integrations across both legacy and new systems.
      • Collaborate with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.
      • Contribute to feasibility discussions and support early-stage prototyping with guidance from peers.
    • Service Reliability & Code Execution
      • Implement backend functionality with attention to performance, readability, and maintainability.
      • Follow team patterns and contribute to test coverage, including basic post-deployment and load testing scripts.
      • Escalate reliability or performance concerns and partner with senior engineers to resolve them.
    • Monitoring & Issue Resolution
      • Help maintain and improve application monitoring by setting up or adjusting alerts, dashboards, or logs.
      • Participate in debugging and resolving production issues, with support from senior team members.
      • Document fixes and share learnings to strengthen team awareness and incident response.
    • Infrastructure & Deployment Support
      • Support infrastructure tasks using established tools (e.g., Terraform, ECS, Lambda) under guidance.
      • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines and participate in identifying workflow improvements.
    • Code Quality & Collaboration
      • Write maintainable, testable code using frameworks like Django and testing tools such as Pytest.
      • Engage in code reviews with a learning mindset and contribute to a culture of quality and shared ownership.
      • Pair with teammates to troubleshoot issues and improve knowledge of system architecture.
    • Product Awareness & Team Contribution
      • Build awareness of how backend systems connect to product goals and customer outcomes.
      • Share observations that could improve team workflows, code quality, or product performance.
      • Seek clarity on priorities and outcomes to ensure engineering effort supports business value.
  • Competencies
    • Collaborative: Open to feedback, communicates clearly across functions, and adds value through shared knowledge (especially during pull request reviews).
    • Curious & Proactive: Suggests improvements in tooling, deployment, or infrastructure and thinks beyond assigned tasks.
    • Detail-Oriented: Writes maintainable, testable code with a strong grasp of debugging principles and Python design patterns.
    • Execution-Driven: Manages time effectively, prioritizes impact, and consistently meets engineering goals without micromanagement.
    • Growth Mindset: Seeks to understand LP’s products and business context to make informed backend decisions and support data-driven goals.
  • Nice to Haves
    • Track record of backend engineering support for Content Management Systems (CMS) preferred
    • Experience with NextJS systems

Qualifications

  • EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of professional development experience using Python and deploying backend systems using Python frameworks like Django or FastAPI.
  • Must Have: Experience with containerized Python/Django (or FastAPI) services, including deployment on AWS.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting production bugs in systems with limited QA support.
  • Strong grasp of SQL databases, CI/CD (especially CircleCI), containerized solutions, and infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred).
  • Comfortable contributing ideas, giving peer feedback via pull requests, and driving technical improvements autonomously.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

  • Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem
  • Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations
  • Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors
  • Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance
  • Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

  • Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel
  • Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines
  • Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic
  • Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)
  • Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation

Implementation & Technical Support

  • Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds
  • Execute technical setup for new client portals
  • Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues
  • Test and QA systems before client launch

System Optimization & Scaling

  • Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps
  • Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability
  • Prepare systems to support increased client volume
  • Document technical SOPs and system logic

Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control
  • Manage user permissions and access levels
  • Monitor system uptime and automation health

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing
  • Translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Automation reliability and uptime
  • Reduction in system errors or failures
  • Time to resolve technical issues
  • Successful internalization of GHL management
  • System scalability and performance metrics

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM
  • Advanced English
  • Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows
  • Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently
  • Strong documentation and organizational skillsAbility to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams

Preferred

  • Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors
  • Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations
  • Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.
